title: Nine Streets Back
subtitle: 旅行住宿 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 旅行住宿（生活与学习·旅行与住宿）
meta: 主题语境：旅行住宿（生活与学习·旅行与住宿）　|　核心词汇：accommodation　|　正文 375 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 accommodation 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: When the ① accommodation fell through in 1987 — a letter, a week late, saying the rooms had gone — my mother stood in a bus station with two cases and said that accommodation is only ever a word for somewhere else until you are standing there. She found the  accommodation on a card in a shop window nine streets back, and the woman who answered said accommodation was not the word she would have chosen for it.

The  accommodation was two rooms above a bakery, and Mrs. Pell said the word had been painted on the card by her husband in 1961, who had been told that in America ② accommodations meant the food as well, and the bed was only half of it. There was ③ accommodation for five, she said, meaning two beds, a table and a stair my brother could not climb, and she said it the way people say a fact they have said nine hundred times.

My mother asked her to make an ④ accommodation for my brother, who was nine, and Mrs. Pell made it without being asked twice and carried him up those nine steps for nine weeks. It was ⑤ temporary accommodation and everybody knew it was temporary and nobody ever said so; accommodation, my mother wrote, is what you call help when you do not want to owe anybody.

In 1994 Mrs. Pell's son wrote that the bakery had gone and the card was still in a drawer; he used the word accommodation nine times in one page and the word mother not at all. We had never reached an ⑥ accommodation about the money — my mother had sent nine pounds every year since 1987 and he had never once answered — and she never came to an ⑦ accommodation with him about it either, because she said an accommodation is smaller than the thing it is about.

I went back in 2003 and the rooms were a shop selling cards, and I bought one and did not write on it, because the ⑧ accommodation I remember is not the rooms at all but the accommodation she made for a boy of nine on a stair in 1987, which is the only accommodation anybody in my family has ever spoken about twice.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. （复数 accommodations）食宿；膳宿供应
C. n. 通融；迁就；照顾
D. n. 和解；调解（come to an accommodation with sb.）
E. 固定搭配：temporary accommodation 临时住所
F. 固定搭配：accommodation for ... 供……使用的住处／空间
G. 固定搭配：make an accommodation for sb. 为某人作出通融／照顾
H. 固定搭配：reach an accommodation about / on sth. 就某事达成和解

items.q: When the accommodation fell through in 1987
in America accommodations meant the food
make an accommodation for my brother
reached an accommodation about the money
came to an accommodation with him
The accommodation I remember is not the rooms

answers.why: accommodation 意为“住宿、住处”，1987 年原本订好的住处落空了，一封信晚到一周。
复数 accommodations 在美式英语中意为“食宿、膳宿供应”，据说包含了伙食，床只是一半。
accommodation for ... 意为“供……使用的住处／空间”，她说这地方能住五个人。
make an accommodation for sb. 意为“为某人作出通融／照顾”，母亲请她为我九岁的弟弟破例。
temporary accommodation 意为“临时住所”，镇上人人都知道那是临时的，却谁也不说破。
reach an accommodation about sth. 意为“就某事达成和解”，我们从未就那笔钱达成过和解。
come to an accommodation with sb. 意为“与某人达成和解、妥协”，母亲也从未在这一点上与他和解。
accommodation 意为“通融、照顾”，我记得的不是那两间屋子，而是她为一个九岁男孩所作的照顾。
